subject: Any R expert grad student need summer employment

messages.author: 025f6f09ad085f30
messages.subject: Any R expert grad student need summer employment
parts:
I'm a faculty research scientist in WFCB using laser ablation ICPMS for reconstructing migration histories in fish ear bones.  I'm in need of some expertise primarily in data manipulation and coding.  I currently have an excel macro written for taking the raw data from the ICPMS and doing some relatively simple calculations.  I'd like to be able to do this in R and integrate the resulting data into statistical and graphical outputs.  I have a Post-Doc working on the statistics and graphical aspects.  We need some one who to do the data manipulations.  This shouldn't be too difficult for someone with the expertise.  I have funds to pay at the GSR level or if you already have a JS or SRA position I can do that as well.  I could probably also pay as a contractor.  IF you are interested in this avenue of research I do have GSR funds for the next three years, so this could be a really hood opportunity for someone. 

Thanks

Jim Hobbs
jah...@ucdavis.edu
